integrity: The full proof is supplied with reversible contractions and exact determinant arithmetic. Finite independent checks supplement rather than replace the infinite proof. General earlier pattern-count theorems are acknowledged. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Order-two de Bruijn cycles only; two distinct length-three factors with common middle letter and four distinct underlying edges; no higher order or shared-edge motifs. Raw joint count formula is covered by general 2006 work; claim is limited to global sign classification and exact alphabet threshold.
title: Sharp alphabet threshold for correlations of three-letter factors in de Bruijn cycles
